name: review
description: Code-review toolkit: nine agents, read-only over the reviewed code, plus orchestration skills for the quality gate and fan-out, a pull-request change digest with an interactive view (/review:explain-change), a merge-risk rating with a demote-only flag (/review:merge-risk), a fan-out sweep workflow (/review:fanout-sweep), and CI lane commands (/review:code-review, /review:security-review) for org reusable workflows.

connected_page_guard_enabled.title: Connected-page guard
connected_page_guard_enabled.description: Runs the PreToolUse hook that denies an Artifact publish of an HTML page whose content security policy names a loopback connect-src. On by default. Turn off to allow publishing such a page.

downstream_probe.title: Downstream probe
downstream_probe.description: run (default): /review:quality-gate downstream mode writes one probe for its safety fact in a temp directory outside the tree and runs it. report: it shows the probe without running it. report here or in a repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml (default branch) wins over run.

fanout_diversity.title: Fanout diversity
fanout_diversity.description: lens (default): /review:fanout run-everything runs one reviewer agent per concern. model: one review prompt per fan-out model tier. codex: the lens roster plus the Codex reviewer as the model panel. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml fanout_diversity wins over this option.

fanout_act_on_cap.title: Fanout act-on cap
fanout_act_on_cap.description: How many rows under each By axis heading (Spec, Standards) of a /review:fanout report are marked act on; default 2, a whole number of at least 1. The other rows stay in the report, marked no. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml fanout_act_on_cap wins over this option.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where /review:explain-change sends a digest page. auto (default): the shipped artifact default, which the publish gate keeps local for a non-public repository or a credential-shaped diff; terminal: no page; file: a local file; artifact: publish anyway; hosted: the shared page host.
